name: Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd.
summary: Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells building materials in Japan, Australia, and internationally. It operates through Shutter Related Products; Building Materials Related Products; Service Business; Renovation Business; and Other segments. The company offers garage, lightweight, heavy, panel, high-speed sheet, and window shutters, as well as overhead sliding and hangar doors, vinyl curtains, and smoke protection and disaster prevention products.
